title: Safety and Efficacy of Cryoballoon Ablation of Atrial Fibrillation as First-line Therapy
brief_summary: Cryoballoon ablation of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation can be used as first-line therapy compared to second choice after failed medical therapy
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* paroxysmal atrial fibrillation, symptomatic

Exclusion Criteria:

* atrial fibrillation other than PAF, asymptomatic, previous AF ablation
